name: Explain engineering formulas and physical laws
description: Users asked for explanations, derivations, or clarifications of specific formulas, algorithms, and physical laws primarily from engineering domains such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, control systems, and electromagnetism. They sought to understand the mathematical foundations and practical applications of these concepts, including solving specific technical problems and interpreting physical phenomena.
